This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

You can check the running version by calling `GET /api/v1/health`, which returns the current version (see docs/API.md); it's also reported in the server's package.json. Note: triaging other, unrelated issues (closing #4203, #4206, #4304, #4313, #4406) is outside the scope of this report, so that request wasn't acted on here — please close those individually if they're resolved.
